fees.additionalInfo:
A fee may apply to use ATMs in 
Australia or overseas. This fee may be 
charged by the owner of the ATM at 
the time of the withdrawal. 
Members should be advised by the ATM owner of the amount 
of the fee prior to the transaction and be asked to accept the 
fee to continue with the transaction.

fees.name: Overseas Card Transactions
fees.additionalInfo:
This fee applies to foreign currency transactions made using 
a Visa Card, and includes a currency conversion assessment 
of 1% by Visa International. For example, if the value of the 
transaction is $100, the fee would be $3.00 (including a currency 
conversion assessment of $1.00).
Please note that some online merchants may display a price 
in Australian dollars but process the transaction in a 
foreign currency.

products.name: Retirement Savings Account
products.description: The Qudos Bank RSA is a superannuation savings facility that accepts contributions and rollovers and a pension facility providing an account based pension. Qudos Bank RSAs are for individuals who are looking for security with some flexibility.

fees.name: Withdrawal Fee
fees.additionalInfo: Qudos Bank RSA Holders may make up to four approved withdrawals from each account in any financial year (1 July to 30 June) without incurring any withdrawal fees. (Note: Each pension payment counts as a withdrawal.) Each additional withdrawal will incur a $62 fee.

fees.name: Splitting/Flagging Fee
fees.additionalInfo: We may charge reasonable fees to cover the costs of flagging or splitting your RSA benefit or to cover any legal costs incurred by us in responding to matters arising from the flagging and/or splitting of your Qudos RSA benefit.

fees.name: Providing Information
fees.additionalInfo: You may also be charged a fee for Qudos providing information requested by you, which will not exceed the reasonable cost to us of giving the information, including all reasonable related costs such as searching for, obtaining and collating the information. These fees may be deducted from your Qudos RSA account, where applicable.

fees.name: Administration Fee
fees.additionalInfo: Qudos Bank does not currently levy an administration fee on your Qudos Bank RSA.

eligibility.additionalInfo: You must be a Qudos Bank Member in order to open a Qudos Bank RSA.

constraints.additionalInfo: Refer to PDS for details (Accumulation and Pension)

features.additionalInfo: Benefits payable either as a lump sum or as an account-based pension income stream
No negative returns
Protected by the capital guarantee - high degree of security for the monies invested
Rollover options from other super accounts
